nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of current contract owner, set from msg.sender at deployment.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used by two-step ownership transfer.
MGUToken.symbol public string token symbol.
MGUToken.name public string token name.
MGUToken.decimals public uint8 token decimals.
MGUToken._totalSupply total minted supply.
MGUToken.balances mapping of account balances, written by transfer/transferFrom and the misnamed initializer.
MGUToken.allowed nested mapping of allowances, written by approve/approveAndCall and spent by transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul: c = a * b with overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0); c = a / b.
Owned.Owned() constructor: owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages new owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): require(msg.sender == newOwner); completes ownership transfer.

function MooguToken() public - name does not match contract MGUToken, so it is a publicly callable initializer rather than a constructor; it rewrites symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits balances of a fixed address.
MGUToken.totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
MGUToken.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: reads balances mapping.
MGUToken.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender with safeSub and credits 'to' with safeAdd.
MGUToken.approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
MGUToken.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
MGUToken.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: reads allowed mapping.
MGUToken.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender contract receiveApproval.
MGUToken fallback function () public payable: reverts, rejects ETH.
MGUToken.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to arbitrary ERC20 transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for ownership, balance and allowance accounting.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract after allowance state change.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, attacker-supplied token contract.
Balance arithmetic in transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...); balances[to] = safeAdd(...).
Balance/allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to].
uint a: first operand of SafeMath functions.
uint b: second operand of SafeMath functions.
address _newOwner: pending owner supplied to transferOwnership.
address tokenOwner: account queried by balanceOf/allowance.
address spender: allowance beneficiary in approve/allowance and callback target in approveAndCall.
address to: recipient of the transferred tokens.
uint tokens: amount moved or approved in transfer, approve, transferFrom, approveAndCall and transferAnyERC20Token.
address from: debited account in transferFrom.
bytes data: opaque payload forwarded to the spender in approveAndCall.
address tokenAddress: externally supplied ERC20 contract address in transferAnyERC20Token.
uint c: return value holding the arithmetic result in SafeMath functions.
bool success: return flag of transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall/transferAnyERC20Token.
uint balance: named return of balanceOf.
uint remaining: named return of allowance.

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership runs.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the transfer.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] and relies on the caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender into the external callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, i.e. msg.sender must equal owner.
Owned constructor stores msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable under onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, transferring privilege.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after completion.
misnamed initializer writes symbol = '0MGU'.
misnamed initializer writes name = '0 Moogu Token'.
misnamed initializer writes decimals = 18.
misnamed initializer writes _totalSupply = 100000000000000000000000000.
since the function name differs from the contract name it is publicly callable, so anyone can re-run it and rewrite balances[0x8567...] and total supply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer debits the sender through safeSub to guard against underflow.
transfer credits the recipient through safeAdd to guard against overflow.
approve overwrites the allowed nested mapping entry.
transferFrom debits the 'from' balance and credits the 'to' balance.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balance and allowance reduction.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance increase.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance before invoking the spender.
approveAndCall makes an external call into the attacker-controlled spender contract.
the callback executes while allowance state is freshly written, allowing re-entrant calls into approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on a caller-supplied token contract.
the external ERC20 transfer is directed to the privileged owner address.
transfer performs its balance math through the safe arithmetic helpers.
transferFrom performs its balance and allowance math through the safe arithmetic helpers.
the transfer arithmetic writes the balances mapping.
the transferFrom arithmetic writes the balances mapping.
the transferFrom arithmetic writes the allowed mapping.
safeAdd stores its result in the local c.
safeSub stores its result in the local c.
safeMul stores its result in the local c.
safeDiv stores its result in the local c.
safeAdd consumes the parameter a.
safeAdd consumes the parameter b.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender keys the allowance written by approve.
spender keys the allowance read by allowance.
spender is the untrusted contract address that approveAndCall invokes.
to is the credited account in transfer.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount fed into safeSub/safeAdd in transfer.
tokens is stored as the approved allowance.
tokens is the amount deducted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
tokens is approved and forwarded into receiveApproval.
tokens is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
from is the account debited by transferFrom.
data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is the caller-controlled contract cast to ERC20Interface inside an onlyOwner function.
transferAnyERC20Token always sends the recovered tokens to the owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: uint a only exists as an arithmetic operand inside the SafeMath helpers.
uint b only exists as an arithmetic operand inside the SafeMath helpers.
the pending owner parameter is only consumed by transferOwnership.
the queried account parameter is only a mapping key for balance/allowance reads.
the spender parameter only exists to key the allowance mapping and callback target.
the recipient parameter only exists as the destination of the balance update.
the amount parameter only exists as the arithmetic operand of token movement.
the debited account parameter is only used inside transferFrom.
the payload parameter is only forwarded through the approveAndCall callback.
the token contract parameter is only used to build the external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
the local arithmetic result belongs to the SafeMath helper that computes it.
the boolean return flag is only meaningful as the success value of the token operations.
the named balance return only exists inside balanceOf.
the named remaining return only exists inside allowance.
